info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Olivine Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Olivine Syrup Detail Creation API is designed to facilitate the addition of new product details to the catalog for olivine syrup. This API is primarily used by product managers and inventory systems to ensure that the catalog remains up-to-date with the latest product information. It enables users to input detailed attributes such as flavor profile, packaging size, and pricing. By leveraging this endpoint, businesses can enhance their product offerings and provide better service to customers through accurate and comprehensive catalog data.
